text:
eli: Hi team — quick one. I see two charges for the Sausalito ferry on the Redwood corpcard for yesterday: $12.75 and another $12.75 (merchant 'SAUSALITO FERRY'). Likely a duplicate tap. I have the boarding pass photo and my AMEX screenshot. Should we dispute the duplicate or mark for refund/reimbursement? cc @marco
marco: Thanks @eli. If corpcard shows duplicate same-day charges we usually escalate to payments ops to request merchant reversal first. Can you confirm the ride time and attach both statement lines?
eli: Attached screenshots in Expensify report: https://expensify.com/report/ferry-dup (two lines shown, same timestamp pretty close). Trip time ~18:05. Also rode with a teammate (paid personal) — not splitting on corpcard.
payments-bot: Payment issue logged: case PF-9842 created for merchant dispute request. Status: pending merchant response (48-72 hrs).
marco: OK we'll start merchant dispute. If merchant doesn't reverse, finance will one-time adjust and refund the duplicate. @sam will need to approve exception if merchant declines.
sam: Approved in principle. If merchant doesn't reverse within 5 business days, finance to reimburse the duplicate and reverse from corpcard reconciliation. Please keep notes in the Expensify report.
eli: Thanks. One extra Q: there was a $3 tip added on a separate line by the ferry kiosk. Policy says tips under $5 on transit/parking are allowed; is that reimbursable on corpcard?
marco: Transit tips are allowed under 'Misc travel fees' if under $5 and business-related. Add a note explaining why it was charged and we'll include it.
eli: Added notes: "duplicate charge suspected; tip for kiosk card reader; business travel to client site." Uploaded boarding photo + both statement lines. Thanks all.
payments-bot: Update: PF-9842 merchant response deadline 2026-03-27. Will notify when resolved.
